purpose: Read-only AInvest global macro catalogs and numeric histories as JSON, independently of visualization.

cli.indicator: source metric code, discover available pairs with --list-indicators --country AU
cli.list-indicators: list actually available indicators for one country
cli.source-input: optional explicit raw source handoff, no network

dataContract.history: All {t:epoch milliseconds,v:number|null,period:original observation period,label:UTC date}; preserve duplicate timestamps, nulls, source units and actual coverage
dataContract.source: AInvest endpoints, original fetchedAt and full source history request; retrieval time is not observation period
dataContract.availability: Country-specific; unavailable source history fails without synthetic substitutes

agentContract.handoff: Reuse the JSON file downstream. Choose an appropriate generic-chart renderer and its schema from the user's question and the data; no fixed chart type, chart count, data cutoff or display template. Compare countries only after checking compatible units, frequency and observation periods. Factor relationships use read_macro_relations.py and preserve opaque source IDs, direction and scores; never invent numeric mappings or interpret source pass_score as correlation.
